name: Methodology Creation and Registration
description: Draft a methodology with content-depth-gated rules, register it in the index and both stores — what the meta-loop does, as a deliberate plan.

steps.description: Draft the methodology: principles, heuristics and decision rules. Every rule must be a concrete 'if X then do Y' with real text, no placeholders. Hands on the draft as JSON.
steps.name: draft_content

steps.description: Content-depth gate: the draft must have at least one rule or heuristic with real text; reject ellipsis shells and prompt-example echoes, and say why. Hands on the validated draft or the rejection reasons.
steps.name: depth_gate

steps.description: Specify persisting the validated methodology to assets/methodologies and both stores and registering it in the index (bootstrap default and zsei_data). Hands on the methodology body and index entry. Registration is done through the MethodologyCreate pipeline, which a blueprint step cannot name; the capability is recorded.
steps.name: persist_and_register

missing_capabilities: methodology registration as a callable action (MethodologyCreate pipeline 12 cannot be named by a blueprint step)
